q.line: Smell of a stonefruit being cut and being opened
stanza: Rowing along, among the reeds, among the rushes
I heard your song, before my heart had time to hush it!
Smell of a stonefruit being cut and being opened
Smell of a low and of a lazy cinder smoking

partner.line: Smell of a low and of a lazy cinder smoking

stanza: I was dreaming in my dreaming
Of an aspect bright and fair
And my sleeping, it was broken
But my dream, it lingered near
In the form of shining valleys

partner.line: And my sleeping, it was broken
